findings.summary: A rolled-back repository head could fork the authenticated external history during append.
findings.failure_scenario: Repository head.json is rolled back while the external anchor remains current, followed by a new append.
findings.impact: The newer authenticated history could be replaced by a fork.
findings.minimum_fix: Require exact repository/external head equality before chain extension.

findings.summary: A symbolic-linked receipts directory could escape the repository evidence boundary.
findings.failure_scenario: An untrusted checkout pre-creates evidence/receipts as a link to an external directory.
findings.impact: Receipt reads and writes could leave the declared evidence store.
findings.minimum_fix: Reject symbolic-link components and require receipt realpath containment.

findings.summary: An output publication failure could leave an authenticated receipt without durable evaluation artifacts.
findings.failure_scenario: The configured output destination cannot be replaced after evaluation.
findings.impact: The execution ID becomes consumed while the reviewed candidate artifacts exist only in memory.
findings.minimum_fix: Stage the redacted candidate and execution artifacts before receipt append.

findings.summary: Display-safe model normalization could collide candidate-run identities.
findings.failure_scenario: Two canonical model IDs differ only by punctuation that normalizes to the same artifact segment.
findings.impact: Distinct candidate evidence could become ambiguous or rejected as duplicate.
findings.minimum_fix: Add a digest of the exact canonical model ID to the artifact identity.

residual_risks: Live provider behavior is not exercised in offline CI.
Recommendation authorization composition remains a separately named V1-07 boundary.

state_impact: Preserves one externally anchored exact-head receipt history.
source_of_truth_changes: Durable redacted output precedes receipt commitment and model identity remains canonical.
feedback_plan: GitHub CI replays the complete offline suite after the repair push.
blast_radius: OpenRouter candidate identity and CLI evaluation persistence.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Tests reject head mismatch, receipt-directory links, output publication failure, and model-ID collisions.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: The repair keeps model identity, durable artifacts, repository chain state, and the external anchor consistent before evidence becomes actionable.
